title: Laser Beam
description: Laser Pointer - A simple and convenient laser pointer. Features:- Red dot where you look -Right-click to switch to blue color - Effects: sparks and flame at the hit point - Craftable in the crafting table
body:
🔴🔵 Laser Pointer Version: 1.0.0 For Minecraft: 1.20.1 Loader: Forge 47.3.0

📖 About the mod A simple and convenient laser pointer that will help you point at objects, explain strategies to friends, or simply decorate the game with beautiful particles. Created based on the Echo Shard—an item from the Ancient City.

✨ Features Function Description 🔴 Red laser By default, the laser shines red. A flame appears at the point of impact 🔵 Blue Laser Right-click to turn the laser blue. Electrical sparks appear at the point of impact 🎯 Precise Hit The laser only works on blocks (not in the air) 🔨 Craftable Can be crafted at a workbench 💾 Color memory The pointer remembers the last selected color 🎮 Controls Action Result Pick up The laser activates Aim at a block A colored dot appears Right-click Toggle color (red ↔ blue) 🔨 Craft

Recipe: [Amethyst] [Iron Ore] [Iron Ingot] [Iron Ore] [Echo Shard] [Red Dye] [Iron Ingot] [Redstone] [Blue Dye] Ingredients:

1x Amethyst Shard

2x Iron Ore

2x Iron Ingot

1x Echo Shard

1x Red Dye

1x Redstone

1x Blue Dye

💻 Command If you don’t want to craft or are playing in Creative mode:

text /give @p laserpointer:laser_pointer 🎯 What is it for? Situation Use 🎮 Multiplayer Show friends where to go or what to dig 📹 Video recording Highlight important objects on the screen 🏗️ Building Mark locations for construction 📚 Tutorials Demonstrate mechanisms and schematics ✨ Aesthetics Just pretty particles

📋 Compatibility Tested Minecraft Version 1.20.1 Forge 47.3.0 Java 17+ 📁 Installation Install Minecraft Forge 1.20.1

Download the file laserpointer-1.0.0.jar

Place it in the mods folder (.minecraft/mods)

Launch the game with the Forge profile

❓ Frequently Asked Questions Question: Does the laser work in the air? Answer: No, the laser only activates when pointed at a block.

Question: Can I change the color back? Answer: Yes, right-clicking again toggles the color.

Question: Does it work in both hands? Answer: Yes, the pointer works in either hand.

Question: Do I need the Fabric API? Answer: No, this mod is for Forge only.

🔧 Technical Information Parameter Value Mod ID laserpointer Item ID laserpointer:laser_pointer Max. range 200 blocks Particles Redstone (red) / Electric Spark (blue) Hit effect Flame / Electric Spark

👤 Author Kiti390

🔗 Links Download: (https://modrinth.com/mod/laser-beam)

Have fun playing with Laser Beam! 🔴🔵
